sn12.4:1.2: vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi
sn12.4:1.3: kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jiyyati ca miyyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca
sn12.4:1.4: atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa
sn12.4:1.5: kudassu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassāti.
sn12.4:2.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:2.2: kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā jarāmaraṇanti.
sn12.4:2.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:2.4: jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti.
sn12.4:3.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:3.2: kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti kiṃpaccayā jātīti.
sn12.4:3.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:3.4: bhave kho sati jāti hoti bhavapaccayā jātīti.
sn12.4:4.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:4.2: kimhi nu kho sati bhavo hoti kiṃpaccayā bhavoti.
sn12.4:4.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:4.4: upādāne kho sati bhavo hoti upādānapaccayā bhavoti.
sn12.4:5.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:5.2: kimhi nu kho sati upādānaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā upādānanti.
sn12.4:5.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:5.4: taṇhāya kho sati upādānaṃ hoti taṇhāpaccayā upādānanti.
sn12.4:6.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:6.2: kimhi nu kho sati taṇhā hoti kiṃpaccayā taṇhāti.
sn12.4:6.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:6.4: vedanāya kho sati taṇhā hoti vedanāpaccayā taṇhāti.
sn12.4:7.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:7.2: kimhi nu kho sati vedanā hoti kiṃpaccayā vedanāti.
sn12.4:7.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:7.4: phasse kho sati vedanā hoti phassapaccayā vedanāti.
sn12.4:8.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:8.2: kimhi nu kho sati phasso hoti kiṃpaccayā phassoti.
sn12.4:8.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:8.4: saḷāyatane kho sati phasso hoti saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti.

sn12.4:9.2: kimhi nu kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā saḷāyatananti.
sn12.4:9.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:9.4: nāmarūpe kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatananti.
sn12.4:10.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:10.2: kimhi nu kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti kiṃpaccayā nāmarūpanti.
sn12.4:10.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:10.4: viññāṇe kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti.

sn12.4:11.4: saṅkhāre kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇanti.
sn12.4:12.1: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa etadahosi
sn12.4:12.2: kimhi nu kho sati saṅkhārā honti kiṃpaccayā saṅkhārāti.
sn12.4:12.3: atha kho bhikkhave vipassissa bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo
sn12.4:12.4: avijjāya kho sati saṅkhārā honti avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti.
